notes: CDER API-repackager CGMP letter (Warning Letter 320-24-15): inadequate identity/DEG-EG testing of high-risk components and failure to investigate observed particulate contamination (unidentified colored particulates, insects, hair, fibers) in repackaged glycerin, propylene glycol, and other drugs over a three-month period -- contamination_present is true since this is an actual, confirmed finding, not a hypothetical risk. Glycerin/propylene glycol are component-only ingredients the firm repackages, not named finished products, so products is empty. recall_concern is true: FDA criticizes the firm's own investigation for failing to 'assess the safety risk of contaminated drugs released to your customers, including customer notification,' matching the assess-distributed criterion.
